source_pool: extraction_candidates_v2.json, top-35 by score after batch10 consumed the 7-10 range (score range 6-7, 1252 unreviewed candidates in pool at selection time; 1035 of those had score<=0/no candidate table found by the scanner)
note: Hit rate 25.7% (9/35), consistent with continued gradual score-band decay. One hit (PMC11409092) initially looked like a coefficient table but turned out to be an inflammatory-bowel-disease risk model, not a cancer prognostic signature -- out of scope, reclassified as miss. IMPORTANT DISCOVERY: PMC10900655's 23-gene 'LRGS' lactylation coefficient table is byte-identical (to 15 decimal places) to PMC13114778's (batch10, breast cancer) -- near-certain evidence PMC13114778 (published 2026, two years after PMC10900655's 2024 J Transl Med publication) reused/relabeled PMC10900655's colorectal-cancer model output under a different disease claim. PMC13114778 has been removed from the quantitative model set; PMC10900655 is counted instead under its actually-claimed cancer type (colorectal, GSE81861). See MODEL_TO_DATASET comment in 15_cross_theme_meta_analysis.py and 31_pmc10900655_crc_attribution.py for full detail.
